items.title: options-ui-§20: one key button and Clear per row (owner follow-up to 015)
items.spec: OWNER REQUEST (2026-10-24, binding): 'For all the keybindings in the individual addon > General > Keybindings, just have a single keybinding button and clear button. In the Settings > Game > Keybindings, leave it as is.' THE ROW (lead's design): the binding label, ONE key button, and Clear. The key button shows the action's FIRST key (GetBindingKey's first return) or 'Not Bound'. Left-click listens; a key binds into slot 1 with the client's own slot semantics (the existing lib.__keybindSet(command, 1, key)), so a second key the player set on the game's page is kept. Nothing may be hidden: when the action also holds a second key, the button reads '<KEY1> +1' and its tooltip names every key and says the others were set on the game's Key Bindings page (Options -> Keybindings). Right-click on the button clears the key it shows (slot 1; a second key then moves up and shows). Clear removes every key of the action (unchanged). Escape cancels, combat refuses, the Saved for line, the outcome line and the UPDATE_BINDINGS sync are unchanged. Options -> Keybindings is NOT touched. Rewrite options-ui-§20's 'A row.' bullet: ONE key button, not two; keep the reason a second key must not be hidden by stating the '+1' and tooltip rule instead (the old text said a single slot would hide a key the player set on the client's page; the new rule answers that). Update the 'Behaves as the client's page' bullet (right-click clears the key shown) and the Testing bullet only where it names a slot number. Ripple every live mention of two slots / Key 1 / Key 2 for the keybindings tab: launcher.md, STANDARDS.md (Sections map blurb and the v2.88.0 entry: add the next ruling number naming the owner's follow-up), EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md, NEW_ADDON_CONTEXT.md, AUDIT.md if it checks slots. v2.88.0 is unreleased: no version or date change. bash scripts/check-standard.sh must pass.
items.verify: bash scripts/check-standard.sh all passed; `git grep -nE 'Key 2|two (key )?slots' -- standards` finds no live keybindings-tab rule

In the Settings > Game > Keybindings, leave it as is.' THE ROW (lead's design): the binding label, ONE key button, and Clear. Do exactly as WG-RV2 did, following the INSTALLED /dev-copilot:wow-revendor-libka0s procedure (copy libs/LibKa0s and tests/_kit whole from `git -C ../LibKa0s archive v1.77.0 LibKa0s testkit`, keep the 'LibKa0s icons:' declaration and prune media/icons with the tag's tools/prune-icons.lua). Append a section '## Re-vendor after the tag moved again (one key button)' to docs/revendor/2026-10-24-v1.77.0/05_SUMMARY.md naming the old and new tag sha and the minors that moved. Add any new public Options member to the degradation stub as an inert member if kit surface parity asks for it. Keep the README test badge and docs/test-cases.md equal to the suite. This addon has a General > Keybindings tab: rewrite every live description of the row (docs/settings-panel.md or the addon's settings doc, docs/smoke-tests.md, README, comments in settings/ that name Key 1 / Key 2 / two slots) to: one key button and Clear, '<key> +1' with a tooltip when the game's page holds a second key. A smoke check whose steps change is rewritten and set back to pending (its old owner mark cleared) and listed under Pending sign-off. Adjust any addon test that drove slot 2 through the tab. Do not touch Bindings.xml, NS.BINDINGS or the labels.
items.verify: luacheck . (0/0); lua tests/run.lua green; no authored .lua above 1500 lines (the repo's CLAUDE.md names the exact commands); diff -r --strip-trailing-cr ../LibKa0s/LibKa0s libs/LibKa0s (icons excluded) is empty; `git grep -nE 'Key 2' -- docs settings README.md` finds no live keybindings-tab text
